scenarios.name: Close and restore the model browser while editing a sketch

scenario_steps.name: a part document is open in the MCAD Software with a sketch being edited
the model browser is docked on the left
the user selects the browser tab's close control
the sketch viewport extends into the freed space
a panel-add control remains at the upper left of the workspace
the user opens the panel-add control
the panel list offers Model Browser
the model browser returns to the left
the browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
